name: bilibili-reader
description: Search and read public Bilibili videos through metadata, subtitles, DASH streams, audio segments, and sampled video frames.

interface.shortDescription: Search Bilibili and read public videos.
interface.longDescription: Searches public Bilibili videos, resolves multipart metadata and cid values, reads official subtitles, exposes expiring DASH playurl streams, returns short audio segments, and samples video frames for visual understanding.
defaultPrompt: Search Bilibili for a topic and summarize the best results.
Read this Bilibili video and summarize its transcript.
Inspect the playable DASH streams for this BV number.
